build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$d/frontend/package.json" ]; then npm --prefix "$d/frontend" run dev; exit $?; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exit 1'
build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$d/frontend/package.json" ]; then npm --prefix "$d/frontend" run build; exit $?; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exit 1'

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self' http://localhost:5173; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://localhost:5173; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://localhost:5173; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost http://localhost:5173; font-src 'self' data: http://localhost:5173; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:5173 ws://localhost:5173; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'
